meta.name: ultradustry
meta.author: ARCYDE
meta.description:
Replaces the Mindustry soundtrack with ULTRAKILL music.
The main menu is a black terminal screen with big buttons, a typing diagnostics readout and social links (the standard menu is one click away).
Sector music follows the sector's threat level, guardians get their own themes, quiet moments and captured sectors get calm tracks.
The tracks are NOT inside the mod: they are downloaded from the ULTRAKILL wiki into a folder next to your game data (Settings -> ULTRAdustry -> Music pack), so the mod stays small and loads fast.
